plan.summary: BRO-5097: four review files the T1 gap audit kept reporting. Checked live on 2026-10-11: two are the wrong show/production (Fire Fire, The Visit), one is a Time Out listings blurb (What the Animals Say), and one is a Theater Scene tag archive that now links the real Burning Leaves review. Code change in the same landing: host-scoped Theater Scene tag-archive rule so the tag url counts as provably wrong for the url repair.
steps: Fire Fire: the Times url is a classical review of Julia Wolfe's Fire in my Mouth (Marin Alsop), not the 2026 Arcola play, so flag wrongShow.
The Visit (regional 2026): curtainup visitwtf14.html is Elyse Sommer's review of the 2014 Williamstown Theatre Festival production, not the 2026 production, so flag wrongProduction with a reason.

What the Animals Say: the Time Out page is a listings blurb (unsigned 'Time Out says', dates and prices, no critic or stars); the ensemble rejected it not_a_review eight times and each verdict was wiped by a refetch, so flag isNonReview.

Burning Leaves: the stored url is the theaterscene.net tag archive and the stored text is a Chip Deffaa column about a different play; repoint to the real review (Tony Marinelli, posted 2026-10-11) so the collector refetches it.
